canonical_project: Horinger Intelligent Computing Center (和林格尔智算中心, 云著智算)
owner: Beijing Huazhu Technology / Yunzhu Zhisuan (北京华著科技/云著智算; to be injected into *ST东易 002713.SZ)
notes: New project (not in prior CN registry). ~200 mu site; reported total scale 280 MW (directly reported). Located in Horinger New District (东数西算 national DC cluster). Per *ST东易 (002713.SZ) restructuring filings of 2025-11-14, facility not yet completed/commissioned (尚未建成投产), with disclosed rack-utilization risk; Huazhu Technology committed to inject operator Yunzhu Zhisuan's equity into the listed vehicle within one year of court approval.
